note: Still Waiting case list, carried forward weekly. Verify each case every Sunday against sources that name the person and state each fact. Choose cases by severity and need for attention, not to balance India against World: include Indian cases that matter, and keep the world in view, since cases elsewhere are equally important.

cases.name: Umar Khalid
cases.law: UAPA
cases.status: Supreme Court bail plea filed 4 Nov against Delhi HC's 30 Sep refusal, its third; not yet listed. Trial not begun. Delhi Police call his pleas premature under the Supreme Court's one-year bar
src: IANS via Social News XYZ (5 Nov)

cases.name: Sharjeel Imam
cases.law: UAPA, sedition and other charges
cases.status: Supreme Court bail plea filed 4 Nov says no prosecution witness examined yet; not yet listed. On 14 Nov India's US ambassador said USCIRF, which says he is held for religious-freedom advocacy, has 'no locus standi'
src: IANS via Social News XYZ (5 Nov)

cases.name: Srishti Gupta
cases.law: 11 FIRs over Noida wage protest
cases.status: Artist still jailed; organisers told The Wire (17 Nov) she has no bail in 2 of her 11 cases. A police chargesheet calls her a 'key conspirator'; police deny planting evidence at her home

cases.name: Satyam Verma
cases.law: NSA (order 12 May 2026) plus Noida protest FIRs
cases.status: Journalist held under NSA despite bail in some of his cases. Allahabad HC reserved its verdict on his NSA challenge on 8 Oct; no judgment yet. UP Police allege a 'significant role' in protest violence

cases.name: Dawit Isaak
cases.law: No charge, no trial
cases.status: Held incommunicado 25 years without charge or trial; whereabouts and health unknown. 19 Nov marked 21 years since his last contact with family. Eritrea's president said in 2009 there would be no trial and no release

cases.name: Abdulhadi Al-Khawaja
cases.law: Life sentence (2011)
cases.status: Rights defender, 65, serving life in Jau Prison; family reports heart problems and glaucoma. 31 groups urged France's president in October to press for his release. No Bahraini government response reported

cases.name: Osman Kavala
cases.law: Aggravated life sentence
cases.status: An Istanbul appeals court again refused his release and retrial (14 Nov), despite a binding European Court of Human Rights ruling. Government denies the case is political and says courts are independent

cases.name: Jimmy Lai
cases.law: National security law (collusion, sedition)
cases.status: Serving 20 years, aged 78. On 12 Nov Trump said Xi has not agreed to free him. Hong Kong says he was not tried for his political views and his medical care is adequate

cases.name: Aung San Suu Kyi
cases.law: Coup-era convictions; term cut to about 18 years (AP)
cases.status: Under house arrest in Naypyitaw since April; her son reported his first phone call with her in five years on 22 Oct. Government rejects calls for her release. No new developments reported 15–22 Nov

cases.name: Imran Aliyev
cases.law: Smuggling, money laundering, tax evasion, illegal entrepreneurship, forgery (10 years)
cases.status: Meclis.info founder sentenced to 10 years by Baku Grave Crimes Court on 12 Nov; his lawyer says no credible evidence was presented and will appeal. Authorities say foreign grants lacked state approval and deny his torture claims

cases.name: Dr Hussam Abu Safiya
cases.law: Unlawful Combatants Law; no charge, no trial
cases.status: Hospital director held without charge. A Beersheba court extended his detention by six months on 18 Nov despite health concerns, saying he threatens Israel, his lawyer says. Israel alleges Hamas links, which his family denies

cases.name: Detainees held by the RSF
cases.countcap: held in El Geneina, doctors say
cases.law: Armed group detention
cases.status: Doctors report food shortages and rising deaths in El Geneina; Amnesty documents torture, forced labour and ransom in El Fasher. RSF reportedly seized a defector's family (13 Nov), alleging army collaboration. No other RSF response

cases.name: Najmeh Amini
cases.law: Death sentence for blasphemy; 12.5 years on security charges
cases.status: 23-year-old student on death row in Mashhad's Vakilabad Prison over social media posts; her Supreme Court appeal is still pending (HRANA, 10 Nov). No official statement or new developments reported 15–22 Nov
src: Center for Human Rights in Iran

cases.name: Imaan Mazari-Hazir and Hadi Ali Chattha
cases.law: Anti-Terrorism Act; earlier 17 years under electronic crimes law (PECA)
cases.status: Rights lawyers jailed since 23 Jan. Supreme Court suspended their PECA terms (17 Sep), but a 10-year anti-terror sentence followed a trial in Adiala prison; appeal filed 7 Nov, unheard. Law minister says judiciary is independent

cases.name: Artin Ghazanfari
cases.law: 26 years incl. 'media activities' under espionage-penalties law
cases.status: Baha'i photojournalist with heart failure; judge reportedly refused the hospital transfer prison doctors advised. His appeal is reportedly limited to the Supreme Court (30 Oct). Iran did not respond to CPJ. No new developments reported 15–22 Nov

cases.name: Mountaga Tall
cases.law: Enforced disappearance; no charge disclosed
cases.status: Lawyer and junta critic abducted in Bamako; his son vanished on 16 May. Neither has been charged. Amnesty (3 Nov) says calls for clarification go unanswered; authorities have not acknowledged holding either. No news 15–22 Nov

cases.name: Zied el-Heni
cases.law: Telecommunications Code art. 86 (1 year); four terrorism-related charges (4 years)
cases.status: Journalist sentenced to four more years on 27 Oct over a leaked-audio report; 17 groups urged his release on 5 Nov. Government did not respond to CPJ; no new developments reported 15–22 Nov

cases.name: Idris Khattak
cases.law: Official Secrets Act; 14 years by military court (2021)
cases.status: Rights defender seized near Swabi; Defence Ministry admitted holding him in June 2020. 31 rights groups (13 Nov) say his diabetes goes untreated. Security sources said he passed information to foreign intelligence. No news 15–22 Nov

cases.name: Joshua Wong
cases.law: National security law: conspiracy to collude with foreign forces (10 years)
cases.status: Democracy activist, jailed since 2020, given 10 more years on 5 Nov, keeping him in prison until late 2036. Chief Executive John Lee backed the sentence; UK, US, EU and Taiwan criticised it. No appeal reported

cases.name: Rejaz M Sheeba Sydeek
cases.law: BNS ss. 152 and 353(1); UAPA ss. 38–39 dropped (20 Nov)
cases.status: Kerala journalist held 560 days. A Nagpur court dropped UAPA charges on 20 Nov but framed BNS charges incl. endangering sovereignty; bail not yet heard. ATS alleges Maoist links

cases.name: Sai Zaw Thaike
cases.law: Sedition (Penal Code s.124A); 20 years with hard labour by military tribunal
cases.status: Myanmar Now photojournalist seized covering Cyclone Mocha. Reportedly beaten in Insein Prison and denied kidney treatment. Given CPJ's press freedom award (19 Nov). Ministry of Information did not respond to CPJ
